summary: A large set of WebRender changes improves visual correctness, performance, and robustness across many rendering features: CSS corner-shape and superellipse corners for nicer rounded borders, more accurate gradient and radial-fill math, better anti-aliasing of patterned quads, and fixes for text glyph transforms and device-pixel-scale handling. There are also shader fixes, sprite-sheet sampling safety, resource/shader-cache cleanup, richer debugging/test options, and a new render-backend pooling model so multiple windows can share GPU threads; together these give more consistent, sharper rendering and fewer rendering glitches across platforms. **Users should see fewer artifacts and smoother edges on borders, shadows, gradients, and transformed text.**
